# COR072 `missing-rank-default`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

A `select rank` construct has no `rank default`.

## Why

An assumed-rank dummy can have any rank up to 15: a `select rank` listing only some ranks silently
does nothing for the others. Add `rank default` that reports the unsupported rank.

## Reported

```fortran
select rank (a)
rank (1)
  call apply_1d(a)
end select
```

## Preferred

```fortran
select rank (a)
rank (1)
  call apply_1d(a)
rank default
  error stop 'unsupported rank'
end select
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR072] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR072` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).
